title: Two-word label products, second-moment caps, good collisions

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.39 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins: one fresh 64-bit coin opens the run with probability K/2^64, K = 7203245966965013787, the least integer with (K/2^64) lo_run >= 0.39, lo_run the exact opened-run lower bound of success.md 6.5 (Chen-Stein on good cross-node collisions, conditioning on points; drops, caps, the carry and weak-operand sites of section 3.4 and the fixup meter's cap are charged failure rows). Its expected total work is at most 2^123.484618247165647 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit), 2^7 + (K/2^64) E_run, with an opened run's work at most 74.6509 per leaf E-averaged over 780 groups of 688296 Y-batches (q1 = 536870880) that stop at the first resolving group, every walk, key path, main-pair K2 verification and defect row charged by history-conditional domination (success.md 6.6); the worst case on every run, 2^190.490444 instructions, is disclosed. Each of 2^72 nodes keeps 1024 permanent points X with 6144 TiB of lookup tables (tblx, charged) and generates each batch's 2^15 points Y = C + [m t + n s]P (m < 8192, n < 4) with one shared inverse per step (ygen, charged); six leaves x(phi^t(X) +- Y) per incidence come from one batched inverse per pair of X's (fwd 71.6260 and bwd 1002.6924 instructions per incidence by LD64B table lookups) and are labelled by two 64-bit truncated products per fraction, 161 compared bits (sections 3.1-3.3); records travel two hops in 256-record blocks and join by hash chains at hop-2 arrival (sections 2, 4); every delivery is charged as executed code under section 2.1's premises (FEAT_LS64 locations, 256-byte DC ZVA, finite receive apertures). New against kaankolcu's 2c8fcf0c: pair tables, one LD64B serving two X's (PX), u^2 and v^2 from one square (P1), a two-slot beta window (PAIRB6), limb-0 fold carries (LF3), a canonical-cell bound on the walks' 130-bit fold (C130), two-word label products with second-moment cap rows (SPLIT) and good-collision accounting (Dsym). Peak memory at most 2^135.9995 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^116.2876 units, included; no advice; certificate.py and the run check every declared figure and every ledger row. Built on 2c8fcf0c's lineage with soispoke's flipped grid and lookups (17a007c8) and PX, P1, PAIRB6 and good-collision ideas (145d73c3 to 2b4a9f40), credited in proof.md section 9; no prior acceptance or score is a premise. An analytic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Flip kernels (fwd, bwd, keys) on production points against bit-exact models (two-word fractions, bounds, Fourier and P1 identities, records, indices, labels), ygen's Y-records and tblx's and tbld's tables against exact references, the 3.4 sites, weak operands and fixups (sites.py), both hops on a 4 x 4 machine and the join on toy groups, with LS64/ISA failing tests (machine.py), KEY's canonical cells at small scale, every kernel count against certificate.py, which it runs. Budget-limited parts run at least their stated minimums. Not a production-scale attack.
